summary: A possibility can feel deeply important before you can explain exactly how it will work in reality.
body: A possibility can feel deeply important before you can explain exactly how it will work in reality. When Neptune conjuncts the North Node, inspiration can begin influencing your choices before you know the cost, timeline, or result. Inspiration is useful, but it is not evidence. Give the idea one concrete test: a draft, an application, a meeting, or a budget. What happens when the idea meets ordinary constraints will tell you more than another round of imagining.
